v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Dómine, quinque talénta * tradidísti mihi, ecce ália quinque superlucrátus sum.
text.en: Lord, Thou deliverest unto me five talents * behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * in módico fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good servant, * thou hast been faithful in a very little, enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Fidélis servus * et prudens, quem constítuit Dóminus super famíliam suam.
text.en: A faithful and wise servant * whom his Lord hath made ruler over His household.

text.la: Beátus ille servus, * quem, cum vénerit Dóminus eius et pulsáverit iánuam, invénerit vigilántem.
text.en: Blessed is that servant * whom his Lord, when He cometh and knocketh at the door, shall find watching.

text.la: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Thou good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Potens in terra erit semen eius.
v.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth.

r.en: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

text.la: Laudémus * virum gloriósum in generatióne sua, quia benedictiónem ómnium géntium dedit illi Dóminus, et testaméntum suum confirmávit super caput eius.
text.en: Let us praise a man * famous in his generation, with whom the Lord didst establish the blessing of all nations, and on whose head He made His covenant to rest.

text.la: Deus, qui præ ómnibus Sanctis tuis beátum Ióachim Genetrícis Fílii tui patrem esse voluísti: concéde, quǽsumus; ut, cuius festa venerámur, eius quoque perpétuo patrocínia sentiámus.
text.en: O God, Who, out of all thy Saints, didst choose blessed Joachim to be the father of the mother of thy Son, mercifully grant that as we hold his Festival in honour, we may ever feel his protection.

office.title: S. Joachim Confessoris, Patris B. M. V.
